title: System Overlay
concept: One order for any hard conversation, so it ends with who does what. It comes at three speeds: quick, standard, and for when it’s already a fight.
whenToUse: A fight is starting: say the one sentence from the 60-Second Reset first, then use the quick version (about 90 seconds). Standard: raising something touchy, asking for a change, making a repair or deciding together. Already a fight: it’s started, or it’s the one you keep having, and you can still be kind. Going in circles? Find the step you skipped and go back. A serious hurt needs the slow version, Full Repair.
steps: Warm up: say the warmest true thing you can, and remind each other you’re on the same team. Already a fight? Check you’re both calm first. If either of you is flooded, take a Pause + Return.
Make it safe: if it’s true, say out loud that the relationship isn’t at risk tonight.
Say what happened: describe it, then how it felt and what it meant. The listener hears it in order: how it landed, then what would help, and only then their side.
Ask for one thing: specific and doable, with a time to do it by. If it’s a change you’ll want to see, make it a Proof item.
Agree next steps: who does what, by when, and when you’ll check back.

phrases.text: I love us, and I’m not trying to fight.
When X happened, I felt Y; the impact was Z.

working: B opens with something kind, says it isn’t a breakup talk, then: “When you scrolled while I talked, I felt dismissed.” A hears how it landed before explaining. B asks for ten phone-free minutes at night. They try it for a week and check back on Friday.
notWorking: A opens with “Why didn’t you text about the pickup?” and nothing kind first. A cross-examines, B goes quiet, and by nine they’re arguing about the tone, not the pickup.
activity: A 12-minute practice run: pick something low-stakes, use all five steps out loud, and take turns keeping each other to the order. Then try the quick version once on a minor gripe.
note: Quick version: “Restart: same team.” One warm sentence each, name the one problem you’re both stuck in, then one ask or a Pause + Return.
